Most people have seen movies or TV shows with robots in them, but can
you imagine a world with real robots? Would you like a robot to cook your
dinner, clean your house, or play soccer with you? There is a robot that can.
Its name is ASIMO and it is from Japan.

stairs. ASIMO works as the receptionist at the Honda offices in Japan. It meets
visitors, talks to them, and takes them to the correct rooms. ASIMO can also
